glosses: to grumble (make a low sound, as of a discontent person, an empty stomach, a distant thunderstorm)

examples.text:
Für die geringe Beteiligung macht Reitz vor allem die Unzufriedenheit innerhalb der Partei verantwortlich – eine Unzufriedenheit, die er als strukturell beschreibt:
„Die SPD ist ja 'ne Grummelpartei.“ Die Genossen seien keine „Partei der Optimisten“, sondern Menschen, „die strukturell unzufrieden sind“. Die Sozialdemokraten seien „die Nöl- und Nörgelpartei“, deren Daseinszweck darin liege, das Leben verbessern zu wollen – was ihr jedoch „niemals gelingt“. Entsprechend sei die aktuelle Beteiligung von gut 50 Prozent sogar „vergleichsweise viel“.
examples.translation:
For the low turnout Reitz makes responsible discontent within the party, in particular—a discontent he describes as structural:
”The SPD, to wit, is a grumble party.” It would not be a “party of optimists” but people who are “structurally disconcerted”. The social democrats would be “the party of bickering and bellyaching”, whose sole purpose of existence is to improve wellbeing in life—in which they “never succeed”. To accord with this, the present turnout of about 50 percent is “relative high”.

glosses: einen unzufriedenen Laut von sich geben

examples.text: Er grummelte, denn sie ignorierte ihn.

translations.source_sense_description: einen unzufriedenen Laut von sich geben

glosses: A low thundering, rumbling or growling sound.
The sound made by a hungry stomach.

examples.text: That whiner is never without a grumble to share.

glosses: To make a low, growling or rumbling noise, like a hungry stomach or certain animals.

examples.text: It made his stomach grumble in protest to think the mule was eating, and here he was worrying about her with an empty belly of his own.

glosses: To complain; to murmur or mutter with discontent; to make ill-natured complaints in a low voice and a surly manner.

examples.text: He grumbles about the food constantly, but has yet to learn to cook.

glosses: To utter in a grumbling fashion.

examples.text: He grumbled that there was no grain "in the country" and that people were talking instead of working to provide it.
